sections_blueprint.description: Chapter 01: Experience Timeline with role badges, key impact metrics, and expansion cards

roles.title: Graduate Research Assistant - Advanced Thermal & Mechanical Systems Lab
highlights: Engineered microchannel cold-plate heat sinks reducing peak junction temperature by 18% in high-power EV inverters.
Executed ANSYS Fluent CFD simulations validating convective heat transfer coefficients against physical test rig measurements.
Mentored 20+ undergraduate students in SolidWorks design validation and mechanical testing protocols.

roles.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant - Mechanical Design & Kinematics
highlights: Led weekly laboratory sections for 60+ students on stress analysis, gear train design, and finite element methods.
Graded technical design reports and conducted CAD model compliance reviews adhering to ASME Y14.5 GD&T standards.

roles.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Intern
highlights: Designed lightweight chassis bracketry for robotic arm assembly, cutting structural mass by 22% while maintaining a 2.5 safety factor.
Coordinated with CNC machine shop technicians for tight-tolerance fabrication (±0.005mm) and DFM optimizations.
Performed static and fatigue FEA in ANSYS Mechanical to prevent premature failure under cyclic loads.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Pravin Salla Mechanical Engineering Master's Portfolio with dark blueprint aesthetic using React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, and Framer Motion.
Implement the signature line-by-line text reveal animation and 3D wireframe interactive gear/assembly canvas in the Hero section.
Include a dynamic Resume Download modal offering PDF preview/download.
Ensure all form inputs use Shadcn UI components customized with cyan/blueprint accents and Sonner toast notification on submission.
Every interactive button, input, and card MUST include data-testid as specified.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use pure #000000 background; use layered deep space blues/obsidians like #07090E and #0D111A.
Include subtle blueprint grid overlays using background SVG gradients or CSS patterns.
Avoid generic sans fonts for headings. Use Syne or Outfit paired with JetBrains Mono for technical metrics.
Ensure high APCA contrast ratios for all body text over dark cards.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
